description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that demonstrates fingerprint authentication with cryptography. It handles key generation, cipher initialization, fingerprint authentication, and user interactions for a sample app involving fingerprint security features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating fingerprint authentication, key management, and cryptography integration on Android.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes key store, key generator, cipher instances, checks device security, and sets up fingerprint authentication buttons.

methods.name: initCipher
methods.description: Initializes the cipher with the specified key, returning success or failure based on key state.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Handles the purchase process after fingerprint authentication, showing confirmation messages.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays the encrypted message and confirmation UI.

methods.name: tryEncrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt data using the provided cipher to verify successful cryptography.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates an Android KeyStore symmetric key with specified invalidation behavior.
